premise: Beaver's pond is perfect for a boat; Pinecone floats, Ladybug is captain, and Beaver's bubbles rise all around them.
inspiration: The voyage of Lear's Owl and the Pussy-cat, turned small and safe: a pond instead of the sea, and home again by teatime.
lesson: Adventures are best with friends to share them.

en-US.title: The Pinecone Boat
en-US.text: Beaver's pond was smooth and shiny. [curious] What it needs, said Beaver {beaver:pulse}, is a boat. Pinecone {pinecone:hop} rolled to the edge. I float! she said. {sfx:plop} Plop! And she did, bobbing {pinecone:float loop 0.3} on the water like a little brown boat. [excited] But who will be the captain? Ladybug {ladybug:hop} climbed aboard. Me! Beaver gave them a gentle push with his nose, and off they sailed, round the lily pads and past the reeds. Then Beaver dived under, and blew. {canvas:bubbles 0.7 14s} {sfx:bubbles} Blub, blub, blub! Bubbles rose all around the boat. Pop, pop, pop! [laughs] Ladybug giggled. Pinecone giggled. And when they sailed safely back to shore, {ladybug:live} Captain Ladybug lifted her red wing cases, fluttered her wings, folded them away… and took a very proper bow. {beaver:hearts}

es-ES.title: El barco de piña
es-ES.text: La charca de Castor estaba lisa y brillante. [curious] Lo que le falta, dijo Castor {beaver:pulse}, es un barco. Piña {pinecone:hop} rodó hasta la orilla. ¡Yo floto!, dijo. {sfx:plop} ¡Plof! Y flotó, meciéndose {pinecone:float loop 0.3} en el agua como un barquito marrón. [excited] Pero ¿quién será la capitana? Mariquita {ladybug:hop} se subió a bordo. ¡Yo! Castor les dio un empujoncito con el hocico, y allá que navegaron, alrededor de los nenúfares y entre los juncos. Entonces Castor se sumergió y sopló. {canvas:bubbles 0.7 14s} {sfx:bubbles} ¡Blub, blub, blub! Las burbujas subían alrededor del barco. ¡Pop, pop, pop! [laughs] Mariquita se reía. Piña se reía. Y cuando volvieron sanas y salvas a la orilla, {ladybug:live} la capitana Mariquita levantó sus alas rojas, agitó las alitas, las guardó… e hizo una reverencia muy elegante. {beaver:hearts}

plop.prompt: a small pinecone dropping into calm pond water, a soft plop

bubbles.prompt: gentle underwater bubbles rising and popping at a pond surface
